Unpredictable Legislative, Regulatory and
Tax Environment

Unpredictable regulatory environment
resulting in unexpected change in legisla-
tion/ government directives which can have
an immediate impact on our RtC and Supply
processes, material supply, COGS and gener-
al inability to achieve business targets.
Frequent changes to customs duties and tar-
iffs impacting affordability of our products.

• Engagement and lobbying with the
Ministries of Finance and Tax Authorities
for favourable tax regimes.
• Periodic tax health checks done by tax
experts.
• Tax working group that meets quarterly
to discuss any tax risks and mitigations.
